criteria.text: Every AI service and model called in scope is listed with an owner, including the ones teams pay for themselves
criteria.how: Compare the network, spend and sign-in records of a month with the list the customer has.

criteria.text: Every agent in scope is listed with the tools it can call and what each tool can change
criteria.how: Review each agent's tools with its owner and mark the ones that change records, send messages or spend.

criteria.text: A test prompt with invented sensitive data is caught before it reaches the model, and logged
criteria.how: Send the test prompt from a normal account and follow it to the block and the log.

criteria.text: Ten instructions an agent should refuse are tried, and every one it carried out is fixed and tried again
criteria.how: Run the ten against the agent, fix what passed, and run them again.

criteria.text: The prompt and the answer behind a chosen response can be found within minutes
criteria.how: Pick an answer from last week and find its prompt live.

readiness: The AI services, models and agents in scope listed, with their owners
Read access to the network, spend and sign-in records for a month
The invented sensitive data for the test prompt, agreed with the data owner
The agent to test, in a setting where its actions do no harm
Security, legal and procurement steps known
